title: Affine continuity makes the set comparison counit invertible
statement: For a scheme X and a pro-etale sheaf of sets F [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], suppose F sends every affine ind-etale presentation by affine etale X-schemes [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis] to a colimit of section sets. Then the counit ν_X^*ν_{X,*}F→F [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] is invertible.

proof.text: The invertible comparison unit makes ν_X^* fully faithful. The triangle identities imply that the counit is invertible on each etale stage.
Present an affine ind-etale object by a small cofiltered diagram of affine etale objects. The hypothesis sends its section cone for F to a colimit; classical continuity does so for ν_X^*ν_{X,*}F.
A natural transformation invertible on the stages is invertible at these colimits. Naturality identifies that induced map with the counit. Dense affine restriction detects its invertibility.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof by E4 from the cited argument and the specified categorical constructions.
